name: bentopdf
description: Privacy-focused browser-based PDF tools for editing, converting, signing, OCR, and organizing documents

fields.name: BENTOPDF_PORT
fields.label: R1: App Port
fields.help: Host port used to open BentoPDF in your browser.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O1: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: BENTOPDF_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help:
Official self-hosted BentoPDF image.
Change this only if you want to pin a specific image tag.

fields.name: BENTOPDF_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

ui.overview: BentoPDF is a privacy-focused PDF toolkit that performs document processing in the browser.
what_happens: One BentoPDF container will be created
The web interface will be published on the port you choose
No database or persistent data volume is required because PDF processing happens in the browser
ui.data_location: BentoPDF does not require a persistent data folder; documents are processed in the user's browser.
